assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service description is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The payer denied the claim because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat.
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities.
